Messages.Author: René
Messages.Body:
Hello,

2 questions about "ghoul retainer" of which I couldn't find an answer:

Card text: "Each round of combat"
1. Can a ghoul retainer use a weapon/inflict 1 damage only ONCE each
round or during every strike resolution?

Card text: "Ghoul Retainer inflicts 1 damage" and "or MAY use a weapon"
2. If there is no weapon equipped, is the infliction of 1 damage
mandatory?

Please post an answer,

René

Messages.Author: denis
Messages.Body:
Ghoul Retainer
Type: Retainer
Cost: 2 pool
Ghoul with 2 life. 1 strength.
Each round of combat during strike resolution, the Ghoul Retainer
inflicts 1 damage or may use a weapon that is not being used by the
employing minion (or another retainer) during that round. This is not a
strike, although it does count as "using" the weapon.

a) inflict 1 damage
b) use a weapon

so its either: a) OR b)
=> if he doesnt use a weapon, he does 1 damage...

Messages.Author: René
Messages.Body:
Conclusion: Ghoul Retainer:

-can only use a weapon/"hit" for 1 damage (no strike, only at close
range) once each round: during the initial strike resolution.

-if no weapon is equipped, he does 1 damage during strike resolution if
range is close (mandatory), or does nothing if range is long.
Correct?

René
